newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mostly steady on Thursday supported by reseller buying and reduced flour mill run times in several areas, dealers said.
But some dealers said sales sometimes slow in February when feeding needs slow due to warmer weather in some areas.
It is kind of a transition part of the year, one dealer said. But another dealer said February could be "a wild card."

"You do not know what the weather will be. It could be snowy and cold, so we could see steadier millfeed prices," a Minneapolis dealer said. "On the other hand, if it starts warming up, you might have a lackluster market."
In the northeast, the interest has been better for middlings.
"We have a bit of better interest partly due to a cutbacks in some flour mill run times that has sparked a little bit of buying," a Buffalo dealer said.
